newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX takes new run at 4,000 point level.
newsitem.headline: German DAX takes new run at 4,000 point level.

text.p: German shares forged ahead to record levels in Monday's bourse floor trade, as uncertainty in the market evaporated and traders girded up to attack the pychologically-important 4,000 point level on the DAX index.
The 30-share index rose steadily throughout the three-hour bourse trading session to close 30.31 points higher at 3,972.84, just below a new intraday high of 3,974.79.
Prices cotninued to rise in early post-bourse trade,
Dealers had earlier believed it was unlikely that a new record would be struck today, but had said market sentiment was good and further forays into new territory were likely soon.
But the market gained new momentum as the dollar turned higher after initially disappointing with a slight downtrend. The dollar was trading just above 1.7450 in early afternoon.
Traders were clearly optimistic for the share market in the medium term.
"The risk in the German share market at the moment is not to be invested in it," Susanne Schneemayer at Hypo-Research said in a market commentary.

"The status of our multi-factor model improved to show four rather than three positive indicators in the course of June," she said. "Such a status has in the past signaled a performance of 15-20 percent in the DAX over the upcoming 12 months."
A focal point in today's market was ProSieben with shares listing in Frankfurt today. The issue, which was 50 times oversubscribed, was released at the top end of the subscription range of 72 marks.
ProSieben shares began trade at 87 marks and quickly jumped to the closing price of 95 marks. But even the close was below a grey market quote of 106.00 to 110.00 marks seen early this morning.
Retailer Metro was also a feature. Its shares jumped 9.40 marks to 205.50 on the back of news it was in talks to acquire the Makro cash and carry business from SHV Holdings.
